run_launch_training: run the launch_training.py script to start Tinker-Atropos training with YAML configuration and CLI overrides
build_config_from_yaml: build a TinkerAtroposConfig from a YAML file path with optional CLI parameter overrides
create_trainer_run_training: create a TinkerAtroposTrainer instance and run async training loop with FastAPI inference server
parse_cli_args: parse command-line arguments for training config including base model, LoRA rank, learning rate, batch size, and wandb settings
run_fastapi_server: run the FastAPI inference server on port 8001 for the trained Tinker-Atropos model
